decision: Does this content follow our brand's own written voice rules, and which blocks must be revised before it ships?
limitations: It applies literal, whole-word matching and a reading-grade rule to the text you paste. It misses paraphrases of banned words and cannot judge tone or how readers react.
Without a brand avoid-list it falls back to AAJ house defaults. A pass on defaults is not a pass on your brand; check which ruleset the run used.
Conformance is not quality. Copy can pass every rule and still be unclear or make unproven claims; run the aaj-copywriting scorer as well.
The grade-10 ceiling is AAJ's working default, not a published standard. Set it from your brief, or dense technical copy will be flagged.
review: The brand or content lead confirms the parsed avoid-list and grade ceiling are the brand's real rules, and an editor reads flagship pages for tone, since the check only catches mechanical violations.
